description:
Epsilons X is a team of curious minds and tech enthusiasts passionate about space, science, and innovation. We aim to explore new ideas, solve real-world problems, and build creative solutions using technology and NASA's open data.

We're looking for motivated team members with skills in web development, UI/UX design, research, or problem-solving.

You don't need to be an expert. We value creativity and a willingness to learn. If you're ready to build something meaningful, join Epsilons X!
